name: Emil Kowalski skills
what: Set of prose skills for interface motion and design engineering on the web and on mobile: decide whether to animate, choose curve and duration, choreograph groups, audit, remove and tune animations, build gestures, and turn design corrections into rules.
install: npx skills@latest add emilkowalski/skills (the line in the README; the repository read is emilkowalski/skill). Pin a skills CLI version and a commit before you add the line to a project.
toolPrefix: skill names with no shared prefix, for example emil-design-eng, animate, choreograph
evidenceNote: Read from a shallow clone of the public repository: README, license and the skill list with descriptions. Not installed. No skill run. The research saw no hooks but did not audit every skill file.
